title: Chrome's AI-powered Autofill can now dig through your Gmail to fill out forms | TechCrunch
summary: That means Chrome could suggest things you might need to know, like a flight confirmation number, membership ID, tracking information, order number, address, phone number, or credit card number by referencing your email.
